crop.notes: Clipping covers the end of the gas suit report, the whole Amusements column and Local Personals. Only the short Theater Comique paragraph mentions Allen.

title.suggested: Theater Comique to Give Benefit for Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's amusements column noted that the Theater Comique would give a performance on Thursday evening for the benefit of Tom Allen, at which the champion would appear.

metadata.notes: Same page as 536 (March 29, 1876, page 8). The clipping does not mention the gold belt; the current title and summary describe article 536.

facts.fact: The Theater Comique, St. Louis, announced a benefit performance for Allen on Thursday evening, at which he would appear
